entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so sad about it, I've been a VeloFit customer for years and this has never happened.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, what item are you calling about?
It's the new cycling shoes I bought. I was so excited for them.
Okay, I see your recent order for the Spin Class Shoes. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or perhaps a matter of fit?

It's the fit. No matter how I adjust them or position the cleats, I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. It's just so painful, and I really needed them to work. I saved up for these.
Oh, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. That sounds very uncomfortable. Let me just pull up your order details to check on the return eligibility. One moment.
Okay... I just hope I can get my money back. I really needed it for other things.

I understand. Let's see... okay, I see the shoes were delivered 36 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Wait, really? A full refund? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Yes, of course. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return process and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file. Just place the cycling shoes back in the box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any shipping center. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive them.
That is such a relief. Thank you so, so much, Diana. You've really turned my day around.
You're very welcome! I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
